_howToEdit: Each item needs: name, category, description, availability. Everything else is optional.
category must be one of the category ids below: bread, sweets, pierogi, hot, market.
polish: the Polish name, or leave it out.
photo: a file in images/photos, e.g. images/photos/challah-sm.jpg. Use "" for no photo yet; a drawing is shown instead.
price: text exactly as it should appear, e.g. "$1.65 each". Use "" for no price.
priceConfirmed: false marks a placeholder price. Set showUnconfirmedPrices to false to hide all of them at once.
availability: "Every day" or "Rotating – ask in store".
Watch the commas: every item ends with a comma except the last one in the list.
